summary: Operation PAR, a Florida-based substance use disorder treatment provider, identified unauthorized access to its computer network on June 10, 2025, affecting the protected health information of 145,714 current and former clients. The breach was confirmed a year later to contain names, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers, financial account information, medical records, and health insurance details. The Worldleaks threat group claimed responsibility and leaked the stolen data on its dark web site in July 2025. Notification letters were mailed to affected individuals starting June 25, 2026, though credit monitoring services were not offered.
